tweet.text: DeepSeek thinking-mode tool loops require prior `reasoning_content` in each subsequent request with `tools`—even when no tool call occurred. DeepSeek says dropping it returns 400. If using V4 Pro via a gateway, smoke-test a two-turn tool loop. https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode/
